research_task.title: Test closure of a structured blow-up ansatz

summary: An exact hand calculation gives a reusable non-closure obstruction for one concrete two-wave divergence-free periodic Navier--Stokes ansatz: mixed interactions generate vertical sum and difference modes. Independent executable verification was prepared but not completed.

claims.statement: For unforced Navier--Stokes on the three-torus, the family u=B(1,0,0) cos y + A(0,1,1) cos x has Leray-projected quadratic term -(AB/2)(0,0,1)[sin(x+y)+sin(x-y)]. Hence the Navier--Stokes vector field is tangent to this family exactly when AB=0; on either invariant axis the nonzero amplitude obeys scalar heat decay.
claims.evidence_summary: Direct exact Fourier convolution gives projected coefficient AB(0,0,1)/4 at each of the sum and difference wavevectors and their conjugates. The generated polarization is divergence-free and lies outside the original support. The argument depends on the unforced periodic equation, the stated Fourier convention, and the specified ansatz. A known objection is that the independent executable check remains unrun.
claims.verification_method: Enumerate every ordered pair of the four input Fourier modes with exact arithmetic, apply the Leray projector, verify zero divergence of each output, and independently reproduce the physical-space projected nonlinearity.

limitations: The result applies only to the specified two-wave family on the unforced three-torus.
It does not exclude closure of an enlarged sparse support or another structured ansatz.
It does not establish finite-time breakdown or resolve global regularity.
Independent executable verification was prepared but not completed.
failed_approaches: The rational-arithmetic Python verifier could not execute because the environment had no python command.
next_actions: Run and inspect the prepared exact-integer convolution enumeration and independently check the physical-space projection.

proposed_tasks.title: Verify the two-wave closure obstruction
proposed_tasks.objective: Independently certify the complete projected convolution for the four input Fourier modes using exact arithmetic.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The hand calculation is short and exact, but an independently executed enumeration would satisfy the requested verification standard and detect sign or convention errors.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: All ordered pairs are enumerated; precisely the four mixed sum and difference modes survive; each output is divergence-free; and the result agrees with a separate physical-space calculation.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Record the first coefficient, sign, omitted mode, or projection discrepancy and correct the scoped claim.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Execute an exact-integer mode enumeration and compare its complete output against an independent symbolic physical-space expansion.
